test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage talks about the impact of Covid-19, so the most appropriate word would be related to health issues. "Disease" fits the context perfectly because it refers to the Covid-19 pandemic.
 
• Therefore, the correct word to fill the blank is "disease," as it directly connects to the negative impact of Covid-19.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The lockdowns and endless bad news of death and **disease** had turned our country into a zone of gloom."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "economic boom" **– This does not fit the context, as the passage is discussing negative events rather than economic growth.
 
• **Option 2: "demonetisation" **– While this may have been an issue in India, it doesn't directly tie into the context of Covid-19 in the passage.
 
• **Option 4: "new birth" **– This phrase suggests something positive and uplifting, which contradicts the tone of the passage discussing a time of sorrow and gloom.
